pr.title: Fix BRC zero-proposal guard bypass for unassigned producers
pr.description:
Adds a global zero-proposal guard to check_confirm_guard() that prevents
any agent from confirming consensus while any producer in the review graph
has never proposed (proposal_version == 0). Fixes #1648 where
reviewer_contract could confirm before tester proposed because the
per-reviewer guard only checked assigned producers.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_global_zero_proposal_blocks_unassigned_reviewer, test_global_zero_proposal_blocks_producer, test_global_zero_proposal_clears_when_all_proposed in test_action_guards.py
- Manual: Run existing test suite to confirm no regressions (pytest orchestrator/tests/test_action_guards.py)
